item.title: What to think about before making a big ask from your direct reports
item.description: Before piling extra work onto your team, consider the cost and what you can offer in return. As a supervisor, you have some ability to dictate what your direct reports work on. The requests you make should typically fit their job description, though most descriptions have a catchall “other duties as assigned” attached, which is likely to cover you.

item.title: How to avoid being a ‘meat proxy’ when you use AI
item.description: AI can make us faster, but there’s a line between using it as a thought partner and completely surrendering our judgment. “Meat proxy” is the worst insult you can hurl at me right now. The term, popularized in August 2026 by the software engineer Niklas Gruhn, refers to a person who takes what artificial intelligence generates and passes it on to another person without reading or even thinking about the output first. As someone who takes pride in my independent thinking, that is the biggest insult I could imagine receiving, if people thought I was operating under AI’s instructions....
